item.title: PacifiCorp Settles $575 Million Wildfire Claims Amid Financial Pressure
item.description: PacifiCorp, which is owned by Berkshire Hathaway, reached a $575 million agreement with the U.S. government on Friday to settle allegations linked to six wildfires in Oregon and California. The blazes burned close to 290,000 acres of federal land and have weighed heavily on the company's financial position.
